en: A black-and-white postcard view of a waterfront area with several docked passenger boats in the foreground and a large city square with trees and grand stone buildings in the background. One of the prominent buildings looks like a theatre or concert hall. The scene is busy with people walking along the quayside and streets. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Stockholm, Nybroplan, and a publisher imprint appears in the lower-right corner.
